name: Avo – AI Shopping Assistant for WooCommerce
author: corpela

sections.description:
Avo transforms your WooCommerce store into an intelligent shopping destination. It places a sleek floating search pill at the bottom of your storefront (e.g., “What are you shopping for today? →”).

When a shopper asks a natural question like “I need a Casio watch for my wife”, Avo connects to OpenRouter AI to extract buyer intent (brand, gender target, categories, price budget), queries your local WooCommerce catalog, and displays instant matching product cards inside a modern popup modal—complete with one-click collection redirects!

Key Features

  • Floating Search Pill: Pinned at the bottom-center of your storefront with a modern frosted glass aesthetic.
  • Natural Language Intent Parsing: Powered by OpenRouter AI (google/gemini-2.0-flash-001, openai/gpt-4o-mini, anthropic/claude-3.5-haiku).
  • Direct WooCommerce DB Querying: Queries real-time inventory and pricing directly from your store database.
  • Instant Category Link Banner: One-click “Explore Collection: View all Women’s Casio Watches →” button.
  • AJAX Add to Cart: Allows shoppers to add items directly to their cart from the results modal without page reloads.
  • Merchant Analytics & Demand Insights: Track top searched queries, uncover zero-result demand gaps, and attribute sales conversions.
  • Customizable Admin Settings: Change AI model, placeholder text, accent color, and test API connectivity with one click.
  • Rate-Limiting Protection: Server-side nonce check and IP rate-limiting to prevent unauthorized use of your OpenRouter API credits.

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the OpenRouter API to perform natural language intent recognition and generate conversational shopping recommendations.

  • Service Provider: OpenRouter, LLC (https://openrouter.ai)
  • Terms of Service: https://openrouter.ai/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://openrouter.ai/privacy
  • What Data is Transmitted: When a customer performs a search via the assistant widget, their search text query and the store’s public taxonomy names (category and attribute names) are sent to OpenRouter via a secure HTTPS server-to-server request. No customer personal identifiable information (PII) or customer account credentials are ever transmitted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active with published products in your catalog.
  4. Navigate to Avo Assistant in your WordPress admin menu (or click the Settings shortcut on the Plugins screen).
  5. Enter your OpenRouter API Key (obtainable from https://openrouter.ai/keys). You can choose any model including the free openrouter/free tier.
  6. Click Test Connection to confirm connectivity.
  7. Customize optional storefront display settings (placeholder text, accent color, max recommended products) and click Save All Changes. The search pill will immediately appear on your storefront.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenRouter account?

Yes. Store owners must have an active OpenRouter account and API key. You can use the free openrouter/free model tier or low-cost models. Get your key at https://openrouter.ai.

Which AI model is recommended?

You can use openrouter/free to run completely free without consuming API credits, or google/gemini-2.0-flash-001 / openai/gpt-4o-mini for near-instant (1-2s) response times and minimal cost.

Is my API key exposed to visitors?

No. The OpenRouter API key is stored securely in WordPress database settings and all API calls are made server-side through the WordPress REST API with nonces.

Can I place the search widget manually with a shortcode?

Yes! You can place the search bar anywhere using the shortcode [avoaisha_search] in your pages, header, footer, or block templates.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Fixed: Critical search continuity bug resolved. Implemented zero-failure catalog keyword fallback when OpenRouter API key is unconfigured, credit quota is exhausted, or temporary network interruptions occur.
  • Improved: Standardized database queries in Analytics engine with persistent caching (wp_cache_*) and strict WordPress table prefix compliance, resolving Plugin Check warnings.

1.3.0

  • New: Added Merchant Analytics & Insights Dashboard (Tab 5 in Settings) featuring real-time KPI metric cards (Total AI Searches, Conversions, Conversion Rate %, and Missed Demand).
  • New: Added Missed Sales Opportunities table showing zero-result searches to help store owners identify what customers want to buy that isn’t currently stocked.
  • New: Added Top Searched Terms table tracking popular customer queries and direct Add-to-Cart conversions.
  • New: Added date range filtering (Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, Last 90 Days, All Time) with one-click reset logs action.
  • Improved: Refined administrative dashboard layout with responsive 2-column grid and optimized spacing across all setting sections.
  • Improved: GDPR-compliant lightweight analytics storage using custom indexed SQL table with zero customer PII and automated daily log pruning.
  • Fixed: Corrected container spacing, button alignment, and toggle switch margins in the settings panel.

1.2.0

  • Feature: Redesigned admin settings with a modern tabbed navigation interface (API & Model, Widget Design, Mobile Rules, Store Behavior).
  • Feature: Added one-click sample prompt preset templates for instant setup across different store niches.
  • Feature: Added one-click copy shortcode action in the settings screen.
  • Enhancement: Added persistent active tab memory so settings saves retain your active tab.

1.1.1

  • Feature: Added admin setting to hide the floating search assistant on single product pages.
  • Performance: Conditionally skip loading frontend styles and scripts on product pages when hidden.

1.1.0

  • Feature: Smart auto-detection of theme mobile footer navigation bars (Storefront, WoodMart, Flatsome, Astra, Botiga, sticky add-to-cart bars) with dynamic automatic elevation so footer menus are never hidden.
  • Feature: Added automatic page-level exclusion toggle to hide floating search widget on Cart and Checkout pages to avoid obstructing checkout buttons.
  • Feature: Added customizable mobile bottom offset setting in plugin admin settings.
  • Enhancement: Added iOS safe-area-inset support for iPhone bottom gesture bars.

1.0.0

  • Initial release on WordPress.org directory.
  • Floating search pill widget with frosted glass design.
  • OpenRouter API intent extraction engine.
  • Real-time WooCommerce product querying and category matching.
  • Instant AJAX Add to Cart support in modal.
